sections.description:
Yuko Reviews is the best WooCommerce product review plugin with complete customer reviews system for WooCommerce stores – a perfect drop-in replacement for Judge.me reviews.

Collect authentic product reviews for WooCommerce, showcase social proof with photo reviews, and turn customer reviews into a sales driver.

Missing customer reviews costs you sales every single day. Studies show that displaying reviews can increase conversion rates by up to 270%, yet most WooCommerce stores struggle to collect enough product reviews from customers.

Without reviews, potential buyers hesitate, question product quality, and abandon their carts.

Yuko Reviews solves this by automating the entire review collection process, making it effortless for customers to share their experiences while giving you complete control over review moderation and display.

Get Started Free | Docs

Key features of Yuko’s Customer Reviews for WooCommerce

  • Product reviews, store reviews, questions & answers
  • Automated review collection emails with smart reminder workflows
  • Photo reviews with visual review collection optimization
  • Verified purchase badges for authentic customer reviews
  • Multi-product review forms—review all items in one submission
  • Two-in-one forms—collect product reviews AND store reviews together
  • Questions & Answers—Amazon-style product Q&A
  • Beautiful review widgets with conversion-optimized layouts
  • Google SEO rich snippets with automatic schema markup
  • Review import from Judge.me and other platforms
  • Smart auto-publishing with profanity filters and spam control

Get Started Free | Docs

Transform Your WooCommerce Store with Authentic Customer Reviews

Yuko Reviews goes far beyond the basic WooCommerce review functionality. Our customer reviews plugin for WooCommerce handles the complete review lifecycle—from automated collection emails to gorgeous on-site displays.

Send automated, personalized review requests & reminder emails. Collect verified reviews and show them in widgets that actually convert browsers into buyers.

✉️ Automated Review Collection – Make It Easy

How Review Collection Works:

  1. Customer places an order
  2. You fulfill the order and mark it as completed
  3. Yuko Reviews waits (configurable delay period), then sends review request email
  4. Customer leaves a review, rating, and uploads photos
  5. Review appears on your product pages

Smart Review Reminder Workflow:

  • Customer didn’t leave a review? Send automated reminders (configurable intervals)
  • Customer left a review but forgot photos? Send optional photo reminder
  • Customer adds photos to their review
  • Optional: Send reward (10% unique coupon code for their next order)

Key Collection Features:

  • Automated review request emails sent after WooCommerce order completion
  • Drag-and-drop email editor with brand customization
  • Multi-product review submission—ALL products in an order in one form, no multiple links
  • Two-in-one forms—collect product reviews AND store reviews together
  • One-click submission—no account creation required
  • Perfectly-timed reminders without annoying customers
  • Photo review reminders to maximize visual content
  • Reward customers with discount coupons (optional)

Multi-Product Review Collection

Use a single form to collect reviews when an order contains multiple items:

  • One intelligent form for all purchased products
  • No separate email requests for each product.
  • Single, organized form respects customers’ time
  • No confusion, no multiple emails, no friction
  • Dramatically improves product review collection rates

💎 Review Display & Widgets to Boost Sales

Turn visitors into customers with strategically placed review displays—social proof increases conversion rates by up to 12x.
See examples

Product Page Review Widget
Display WooCommerce product reviews with ratings, photos, and verified badges directly on product pages—complete social proof that converts browsers into buyers

Star Rating
Show product star ratings and review counts on category pages and listings to help shoppers identify top-rated items instantly

Floating Review Bar
Persistent floating widget opens a slideout with all product reviews, store reviews, and Q&A—keeping social proof accessible throughout the customer journey

Review Slider / Carousel
Auto-rotating testimonial carousel for homepages and landing pages—showcase your best customer reviews without consuming page space

Wall of Love / All Reviews Page
Dedicated testimonials page displaying your complete WooCommerce review collection—perfect for building brand credibility and SEO value

Questions & Answers Widget
Amazon-style product Q&A sections where customers ask questions and find answers—reduce support tickets while increasing purchase confidence

Plus,

  • Showcase widgets at any location using short codes.
  • Multiple layout options (grid, slider, list, carousel)
  • Mobile-optimized display for all devices
  • Automatic product page integration
  • Rating summary statistics (5-star breakdown)
  • Custom colors, fonts, and styling options

Customer reviews generate unique, SEO-rich content automatically. Show star ratings directly in Google search results, dominate Google Shopping, and watch your organic traffic grow—all without lifting a finger.

Amplify your social proof:

Plus,

sections.installation:
Quick Setup:

  1. Sign up for account at https://app.yukoapp.com
  2. Install and activate the plugin
  3. Connect with Yuko dashboard
  4. Set review request email timing (recommended: 7-14 days after fulfillment) & customize the email
  5. Customize product reviews, star rating, and sidebar widgets
  6. Select moderation preferences (automatic or manual approval)

That’s it! Yuko Reviews automatically begins sending review requests based on your settings. New reviews appear on product pages after approval.
sections.faq:
What makes Yuko Reviews different from other WooCommerce review plugins?

Yuko Reviews is built specifically for WooCommerce stores with focus on:

  • Capturing more visual reviews through automation
  • Conversion optimization for maximum sales impact
  • Automated review collection emails
  • Photo uploads
  • Verified purchase badges
  • Multiple customizable display widgets
  • Complete WooCommerce review management dashboard
  • Minimal ongoing effort required

Our customer review plugin for WooCommerce gives you complete control while collecting more customer reviews and increasing sales.

How to collect customer reviews in WooCommerce automatically?

After completing a WooCommerce order, Yuko Reviews automatically:

  1. Schedules review request email (typically 7-14 days after purchase. Configurable)
  2. Gives customers time to receive and use products
  3. Sends email with direct link to simple review form
  4. Customers submit rating, written review, and optional photos
  5. No account creation or complex steps required

Can customers upload photos with their product reviews?

Yes! Photo and video reviews are one of Yuko’s most powerful features:

  • Customers easily upload images and videos
  • Mobile-optimized review forms
  • Visual testimonials appear prominently on product pages
  • Authentic social proof boosts conversion rates significantly
  • You control which media displays via moderation dashboard

How do verified purchase badges work?

Yuko Reviews automatically:

  • Identifies reviews from customers who purchased products
  • Verifies through your WooCommerce store
  • Displays special “Verified Purchase” badge
  • Signals authenticity to potential buyers
  • Matches reviewer email with completed WooCommerce orders
  • Badge only appears on genuine customer feedback

Will Yuko Reviews help my products appear in Google search results with star ratings?

Absolutely. Yuko Reviews automatically:

  • Adds structured data (schema markup) to WooCommerce product pages
  • Enables Google to display star ratings in search results
  • Rich snippet functionality improves click-through rates significantly
  • Verify implementation using Google’s Rich Results Test tool

Note: Valid schema markup makes you eligible for organic stars, but Google decides whether to display them.

How does this WooCommerce review system compare to other review plugins?

Unlike basic review plugins for WooCommerce, Yuko Reviews functions as complete product review system:

  • Advanced features for collecting product reviews for WooCommerce stores
  • Automated collection, photo reviews, verified badges
  • Professional WooCommerce review management
  • Features typically found in premium WooCommerce review extensions
  • Handles both product reviews and customer ratings
  • WooCommerce testimonials display options increase conversions
  • Simple product review collection to comprehensive WooCommerce customer feedback management
  • Review plugin WooCommerce integration provides everything in one solution

Does Yuko Reviews collect store reviews in addition to product reviews?

Yes! Yuko Reviews captures both:

  • Product-specific feedback
  • Overall store reviews in single collection process
  • Rate complete shopping experience (shipping, customer service, checkout)
  • Product reviews appear alongside store reviews
  • Store reviews shown separately from product reviews
  • Build overall store credibility
  • Complete insights into customer satisfaction across every touchpoint

How does the Questions & Answers feature work?

The Q&A system works like Amazon:

  • Customers ask questions directly on product pages
  • You receive notifications of new questions
  • Provide answers from your dashboard
  • Questions and answers appear publicly on product page
  • Other customers can contribute answers
  • Creates helpful community resource
  • Reduces repetitive support inquiries
  • Provides pre-purchase information shoppers need
  • Q&A content improves SEO with relevant, keyword-rich content

Can I customize the review request emails to match my brand?

Yes! All review collection emails are fully customizable:

  • Edit email subject line, body text, button text
  • Add your logo and brand colors
  • Create different templates for different customer segments
  • Customize by products or order types
  • Email editor includes merge tags
  • Personalization: customer name, product name, order number

Can I import existing reviews from another platform?

Yes! Yuko Reviews includes powerful import tools:

  • Support CSV files and common review platform formats
  • Migrate from Judge.me or any other review system
  • Import existing customer reviews (ratings, text, photos, dates)
  • Don’t lose valuable social proof when switching
  • Import wizard guides through field mapping
  • Ensures accurate data transfer

Does Yuko Reviews work with my WooCommerce theme?

Yuko Reviews is designed for seamless compatibility:

  • Works with any properly coded WooCommerce-compatible theme
  • Review widgets automatically inherit theme styling
  • Extensive customization options available
  • Support team provides custom CSS if needed
  • Tested with popular themes: Storefront, Astra, Flatsome, Divi

How do I handle negative reviews?

Negative reviews are opportunities to demonstrate excellent customer service:

  • Respond directly explaining how you’ll address concerns
  • Reach out privately to resolve issues before review goes live
  • Use feedback to improve products and services
  • Moderation system gives full control
  • We recommend displaying authentic negative reviews with thoughtful responses
  • Transparency increases overall trust

Can I offer discount codes or incentives for leaving reviews?

Yes! Yuko Reviews supports incentivized review collection:

  • Built-in discount code generation
  • Automatically send coupon codes after review submission
  • Include codes in initial review request email

Important: When using incentives, ensure proper disclosure per FTC & other legal guidelines.
